overall_verdict_text: Only one p>=5 (variable-step) fully stage-parallel Peer-W parameter set was found in readable primary text: PPSW2-6 (s=6, p=s-1=5) in the Halle preprint of Weiner-Schmitt-Podhaisky (APNUM 48, 2004). Its printed data are nodes c and gamma0/gamma1 (<=9 decimals), NOT the B/A/G matrices; matrices must be derived via eqs (3.9),(3.10),(4.3),(4.5). Journal version not read. Zero-stability interval [sigma_a,sigma_b] not printed numerically (UNRESOLVED). No complete tableau in explicit matrix form was found. The only fully printed p=5 variable-step table (IP4o5, Lang-Schmitt 2026) is NOT stage-parallel and NOT Peer-W.

stage_parallel.quote: Obviously, with s processors all s values Y_mi can be computed in parallel. (Sec 3, after eq 3.1)
stage_parallel.form: (I - gamma_i h_m T_m) Y_mi = sum_j (b_ij I + h_m d_ij T_m) Y_{m-1,j} + h_m sum_j a_ij f(t_{m-1,j}, Y_{m-1,j})

candidates.step_ratio_domain: Thm 4.2: exists [sigma_a,sigma_b], sigma_a<1<sigma_b, for strongly stable methods; numeric values NOT printed; implementation limits sigma<=sigma_max=1.5 (PPSW2-3,4,Super2) and 1.2 for the others incl. PPSW2-5, PPSW2-6 (Sec 5). 'For larger s the bounds can be rather close to one.' Fig 4.2 bnorm vs sigma_max (curve values not read)
candidates.zero_stability: 'strongly stable' (Def 3.4: eigenvalues of B(1): lambda_1=1,|lambda_i|<1) asserted for the listed PPSW2 methods ('Some fairly good strongly stable methods have been found'); eigenvalues of B(1) NOT printed -> UNRESOLVED, must be recomputed
candidates.startup: starting values computed with ROWMAP in the tests; Thm 3.1 requires ||Y_0i - y(t0+c_i h0)||=O(h0^p)
candidates.error_estimator: (4.4): Y_ms - sum_j theta_sj Y_{m-1,j}; one superconsistent stage (gamma_s fixed by 4.3) gives higher-order local error estimate. PPSW1 uses embedded O(h^{s-2}) solution
candidates.coefficients_printed: Only parameters: nodes c, gamma0, gamma1 with gamma_i=gamma0_i/(1+sigma*gamma1_i) (4.5), gamma_s from (4.3). B,A,G,Theta must be built from (3.8)-(3.10),(4.1)-(4.3). B(sigma)=Theta-sigma G Theta V D F0^T V^-1 (Thm 4.2 proof).
